Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was changing lanes on a busy road in Pasadena, Texas, when the car in the lane beside me drifted over and clipped
the side of my vehicle. I felt the jolt through the steering wheel and pulled onto the shoulder as soon as I could safely
do so. The other driver stopped as well, and we exchanged the details we needed. My knee struck the door frame
during the impact, and by the time I got out of the car it was stiff and painful. I have been the named driver on this
policy for several years, and I am reporting the collision as it happened. Since my first statement at the scene, I have
remembered a few smaller points, such as the traffic signal ahead and the weather that afternoon, but the core of
what happened has not changed.
